title: Inbox
description: Full inbox snapshot, desktop → phone (SPEC.md §4.4). Describes what a sender must produce. Receivers also ignore unknown fields, treat null optional fields as absent, and show an unknown tab status as idle.

pinned.description: The desktop sidebar's Pinned list, in its order (SPEC.md §4.4). Absent when nothing is pinned.

streamId.description: Set when the pin is a stream of the project, and on a task pin (the task's stream).

taskId.description: Set when the pin is a task of the project rather than the project or a stream.

main.description: The project's default stream (its folder); exactly one per project.

branch.description: Present on a worktree stream: the git branch of its worktree (SPEC.md §4.4).

streams.description: Open streams in sidebar order, main first.

lastStreamId.description: The stream the project was last used in.

status.description: The task's one status: the strongest of its main tab's and agent tabs' (SPEC.md §4.4).

eventAt.description: The task's last event: a hook notification or stop, a terminal bell, a process exit (SPEC.md §4.4).

unread.description: Present while the desktop counts the task unread (SPEC.md §4.4).

settledAt.description: Present while the task is settled (SPEC.md §4.4).

snoozedUntil.description: Present while a timed snooze hasn't passed at generatedAt (SPEC.md §4.4).

snoozeUntilAttention.description: Present while the task is snoozed until it needs the user (SPEC.md §4.4).

type.description: M1 desktops send claude-chat, claude, codex, pi or terminal; receivers accept any string.

activity.description: Short label derived from AgentActivity, e.g. "Running Bash".

topic.description: What an agent tab's conversation is about: Claude's session title, else the last prompt.
